fusions.name: Bitter Tooth
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 4 damage and passes on the poison you have drawn: the target is [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% per affliction on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Cull the Sickly
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A throat bite that deals 18 damage and draws out every affliction on the target, adding 1.4 times their remaining damage to the hit.

fusions.name: Lick It Clean
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you and your allies, and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Strong Stomach
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You have 12% poison resistance.
